topics.name: Iran war and Hormuz
topics.now: President Trump says a US blockade of Iran's land supply routes is in effect but calls new strikes highly unlikely while talks on Iran's nuclear program and reopening the Strait of Hormuz progress. Iran threatens to retaliate against any attack, and Yemen's Houthis hit Aramco's Riyadh tower on November 8. Brent traded near $97 a barrel on November 9 after a 16% weekly fall.

topics.now: The central bank's dollar selling rate stood at EGP 54.31 on November 8, up from 54.01 three days earlier but below the late-October record of 56.20. Policy rates are 20% for deposits and 21% for lending, and the one-year T-bill yielded 26.03% at the November 5 auction; the next rate meeting is December 17.

topics.name: AI spending and chip stocks
related: Wall Street on the Markets Desk
topics.now: Wall Street's AI selloff eased on November 6, with Nvidia up 2.8%, but the S&P 500 still had its worst week since June. Nvidia's board is now investigating chief executive Jensen Huang over a relationship with a woman accused of spying for China, and Anthropic faces pressure to cut its planned $1.5 trillion IPO valuation.

topics.name: US midterms
topics.now: Democrats won both chambers of Congress on November 3 and take control in January. House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries backs impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, while Trump has asked the Justice Department to investigate Democrats; removal of Hegseth would need two-thirds of the Senate.

topics.name: Banque du Caire listing
related: Banque du Caire on the Markets Desk
topics.now: Banque du Caire began trading on November 2, closing its first session at EGP 5.31 against the EGP 5.30 offer price, and edged up to about EGP 5.58 by November 5. The Finance Ministry will take up to half of the EGP 36.37 billion raised to ease debt pressure.

topics.name: Gas supply to fertilizer plants
related: Abu Qir on the Markets Desk
topics.now: The government raised gas curtailments for fertilizer and methanol plants to 33% on November 8, from 20% imposed on November 1, and notified Ezz Steel of a 30% cut, as spot LNG cargoes cost close to $120 million each. Mopco and Abu Qir Fertilizers each fell almost 6% on the EGX that day; no producer has yet put a figure on the lost output.

topics.name: Egypt and the IMF
related: The pound on the Markets Desk
topics.now: The IMF mission on Egypt's eighth and final review aims to take it to the Fund's board before the program ends on December 15, with about $2.3 billion at stake. The government plans an Egypt Aluminum stake sale and has put off a freezone levy of up to 4% until after the review.

topics.name: Gaza and Lebanon
topics.now: Gadi Eisenkot formally received Israel's mandate to form a government on November 8 and has 28 days, extendable by 14; he says he is open to including Benjamin Netanyahu, who remains caretaker prime minister.
